name: @gears-frontx/frontx-template-calendar
description: Standalone seed for the calendar feature, not an overlay onto template-shell: the @gears-frontx/calendar-kit React component library (week, day, month and agenda views, availability grid, event creation, search and sidebar widgets) built on @gears-frontx/ui-kit, with its build, lint, dependency and test toolchain. The host owns data, persistence and scheduling rules; the kit exposes a UI data model and callbacks only.
